name: Mayamalavagowla
arohana: S R1 G3 M1 P D1 N3 S'
avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G3 R1 S
hindustaniNotes: Sa, Komal Re, Shuddha Ga, Shuddha Ma, Pa, Komal Dha, Shuddha Ni
westernScale: C, Db, E, F, G, Ab, B, C (Double Harmonic Major)
pakad: G3 M1 P D1 P, M1 G3 R1 S
description: The foundation raga for beginner Carnatic lessons devised by Purandara Dasa due to its symmetrical tetrachords with uniform semitone intervals.

name: Dheerasankarabharanam
arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D2 N3 S'
avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
hindustaniNotes: Sa, Shuddha Re, Shuddha Ga, Shuddha Ma, Pa, Shuddha Dha, Shuddha Ni
westernScale: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C (Major Scale / Ionian mode)
pakad: G3 P, M1 G3, M1 R2, G3 P M1 G3 R2 S
description: One of the major pillars of Carnatic music, representing the natural major scale.

name: Mechakalyani
arohana: S R2 G3 M2 P D2 N3 S'
avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 G3 R2 S
hindustaniNotes: Sa, Shuddha Re, Shuddha Ga, Teevra Ma, Pa, Shuddha Dha, Shuddha Ni
westernScale: C, D, E, F#, G, A, B, C (Lydian mode)
pakad: N3' R2 G3, M2 D2 N3 S', S' N3 D2 P, M2 G3 R2 S
description: A deeply serene, auspicious evening raga distinguished by the sharp fourth (Prati Madhyamam / Teevra Ma).

name: Kharaharapriya
arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
hindustaniNotes: Sa, Shuddha Re, Komal Ga, Shuddha Ma, Pa, Shuddha Dha, Komal Ni
westernScale: C, D, Eb, F, G, A, Bb, C (Dorian mode)
pakad: R2 G2 M1 P, D2 N2 D2 P, M1 G2 R2 S
description: The 22nd Melakarta and mother of famous janya ragas like Kapi, Darbar, Nayaki, and Sriranjani.

name: Hanumatodi
arohana: S R1 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R1 S
hindustaniNotes: Sa, Komal Re, Komal Ga, Shuddha Ma, Pa, Komal Dha, Komal Ni
westernScale: C, Db, Eb, F, G, Ab, Bb, C (Phrygian mode)
pakad: S R1 G2 M1, P D1 N2 D1 P, M1 G2 R1 S
description: A magnificent heavyweight raga in Carnatic music. Note: Carnatic Thodi corresponds to Hindustani Bhairavi Thaat, NOT Hindustani Todi (which takes Teevra Ma).

name: Mohanam
arohana: S R2 G3 P D2 S'
avarohana: S' D2 P G3 R2 S
hindustaniNotes: Sa, Shuddha Re, Shuddha Ga, Pa, Shuddha Dha (Audav-Audav pentatonic)
westernScale: C, D, E, G, A, C (Major Pentatonic)
pakad: G3 R2 S D2' S R2 G3, P G3, D2 P G3 R2 S
description: Pentatonic raga omitting Ma and Ni. Universal appeal found across world musical cultures.

name: Hindolam
arohana: S G2 M1 D1 N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D1 M1 G2 S
hindustaniNotes: Sa, Komal Ga, Shuddha Ma, Komal Dha, Komal Ni
westernScale: C, Eb, F, Ab, Bb, C (Minor Pentatonic variation)
pakad: M1 D1 N2 D1 M1, G2 M1 G2 S
description: A symmetric pentatonic scale omitting Rishabha (Re) and Panchama (Pa). Note: In Hindustani, Malkauns takes Komal Dha; Hindustani Hindol uses Teevra Ma.

name: Hamsadhwani
arohana: S R2 G3 P N3 S'
avarohana: S' N3 P G3 R2 S
hindustaniNotes: Sa, Shuddha Re, Shuddha Ga, Pa, Shuddha Ni
westernScale: C, D, E, G, B, C
pakad: R2 G3 P N3 S', S' N3 P G3 R2 S
rasa: Joy, Celebration, Auspicious invocations to Lord Ganesha
description: Created by Ramaswami Dikshitar in the 18th century, adopted warmly into Hindustani music by Ustad Aman Ali Khan.

name: Charukesi
arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D1 N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G3 R2 S
hindustaniNotes: Sa, Shuddha Re, Shuddha Ga, Shuddha Ma, Pa, Komal Dha, Komal Ni
westernScale: C, D, E, F, G, Ab, Bb, C (Melodic Major / Mixolydian b6)
pakad: G3 M1 P D1 P, M1 G3 R2 S
description: Features a Major poorvanga (S R2 G3 M1) and a Minor uttaranga (P D1 N2 S'). Highly expressive in cinema and classical.

name: Keeravani
arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N3 S'
avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S
hindustaniNotes: Sa, Shuddha Re, Komal Ga, Shuddha Ma, Pa, Komal Dha, Shuddha Ni
westernScale: C, D, Eb, F, G, Ab, B, C (Harmonic Minor scale)
pakad: R2 G2 M1 P D1 N3 S', S' N3 D1 P, M1 G2 R2 S

famousSongs.title: Yaad Na Jaaye Beete Dinon Ki

description: Direct equivalent to the Western Harmonic Minor Scale. Very prominent in ghazals, filmi songs, and classical concerts.

name: Ahir Bhairav
arohana: S R1 G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R1 S
hindustaniNotes: Sa, Komal Re, Shuddha Ga, Shuddha Ma, Pa, Shuddha Dha, Komal Ni
westernScale: C, Db, E, F, G, A, Bb, C (Mixolydian b2)
pakad: S R1 G3 M1, G3 M1 R1 S, D2' N2' S R1 S

famousSongs.title: Poochho Na Kaise Maine Rain Bitai

description: Blends the poorvanga of Bhairav (S R1 G3 M1) with the uttaranga of Kafi/Khamaj (P D2 N2 S').

name: Sindhu Bhairavi
arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R1 S
hindustaniNotes: All 12 notes may be used sensitively (Bhashanga)
rasa: Universal Pathos, Compassion, Climax piece of concert
description: Bhashanga raga taking anya swaras (foreign notes) with utmost elegance. Commonly sung at the conclusion of concerts.
